items.title: Billionaire Brad Gerstner’s Altimeter Opened a $680 Million Tesla Stake and Exited Qualcomm and Applied Materials
items.summary: Altimeter dumped two chip-equipment names, bought a put on the semiconductor sector, and bet big on Elon Musk's robots and robotaxis. Gerstner stays silent on why, but Tesla's own numbers and a steep valuation hint at the real tension.

items.title: Applied Materials Falls 6% Despite UBS’s $575 Target as China Chip Curbs Hit Equipment Stocks; Lam Research Drops 7%, KLA Edges Lower
items.summary: Record revenue, rising estimates, and customers begging for faster deliveries should have kept Applied Materials steady. Instead, a proposed Washington bill has investors rethinking what those earnings are worth, and one rival faces far more exposure than the rest.

items.title: Applied Materials Keeps Sliding: Why UBS Still Sees 94% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS cut its Applied Materials price target to $575 from $640 and kept its Buy rating, after the stock lost 39% in three months. Analysts have raised their earnings estimates through the slide, so almost all of the drop comes from a lower multiple.
